About.title: About TradeInDRC
About.heroSubtitle: A government-backed B2B platform where verified Congolese companies meet international buyers — directory, search, RFQs, and secure messaging in one place.
About.missionText: TradeInDRC is the official bilingual trade portal of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. We connect verified Congolese businesses with international buyers and partners, give the Ministry the tools to moderate and verify every company, and put the country's export capacity in one trusted place.

exporter.title: Congolese exporters
exporter.desc: Register once, get the Ministry-verified badge, list products and export capacity, and reach international buyers actively looking for DRC suppliers.

buyer.title: International buyers
buyer.desc: Discover vetted Congolese suppliers across sectors, send RFQs, message companies securely, and shortlist partners without leaving the platform.

gov.title: Ministry & officials
gov.desc: A moderation console with audit trails, KPI dashboards, taxonomy controls, and featured-profile management — oversight built into the platform.

About.step1Desc: Create an account and submit tax ID, registration number, and certificates for verification.
About.step2Desc: Our team reviews your documents against KYB checks and grants the official Ministry badge.
About.step3Desc: List products, respond to RFQs, and message buyers through our secure inbox — no contact leaks.

directory.title: Verified directory
directory.desc: Rich profiles with capacity, lead time, MOQ, HS codes, certifications, and Ministry-verified badge.

messaging.title: Secure messaging
messaging.desc: Contact-supplier form keeps emails private; messages land in a private inbox on TradeInDRC.

rfq.title: Mini RFQ board
rfq.desc: Post a sourcing need or capacity offer; verified counterparties respond through secure messaging.

references.title: Verified references
references.desc: Link to other verified partners on the platform to build a visible, audit-friendly network of trust.

bilingual.title: Bilingual EN / FR
bilingual.desc: Every UI string and CMS surface is dual-language. Browse and trade in the language you prefer.

analytics.title: Private analytics
analytics.desc: Each company sees profile views, search appearances, and the top queries that surfaced their profile.

pillars.ministry: Every listing is reviewed and signed off by the Ministry before the verified badge is granted.
pillars.kyb: KYB checks against tax ID, registration documents, and sector certifications before publication.
pillars.backed: Government-backed infrastructure with full audit trails and dedicated moderation queues.

faq.title: Some things you might want to know
faq.subtitle: We answered the questions so you don't have to ask.

q1.q: How do I become a verified exporter?
q1.a: Register, complete your company profile, upload KYB documents in the dashboard, and our team reviews within 5 business days.

q2.q: How do I send an RFQ?
q2.a: Log in, open any company or opportunity, and click 'Send RFQ'. You can also broadcast an RFQ to every verified company on a list page.

q3.a: Yes. Registration, browsing, and basic RFQs are free. Premium verification tiers and analytics are optional.

q4.a: English and French today. Turkish, Chinese, and Spanish are planned.

q5.q: How do I contact a company?
q5.a: Open the company profile and click 'Message company' to start a conversation thread. Verified companies typically respond within 48 hours.

about.body: Trade in DRC is the digital platform that connects the DRC to the world of business. We facilitate connections between Congolese companies, international partners, investors, suppliers, and buyers, making trade in the Democratic Republic of Congo simpler, more reliable, and more structured. Our goal is clear: to create a trusted space where opportunities, businesses, and market information become accessible, visible, and actionable.

mission.label: Our Mission
mission.text: Drive trade, investment, and partnerships in the DRC through a trusted digital platform.

who.title: Who We Are
who.desc: A business platform designed to connect companies, opportunities, and market actors across the Democratic Republic of Congo.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.desc: To become the leading digital gateway for doing business in the Democratic Republic of Congo, connecting local potential with regional and global markets.

core.commitment: Commitment to the development of the DRC

transform.lead: Trade in DRC transforms business relationships into concrete opportunities for the

sectors.title: Invest in the DRC's strengths
sectors.subtitle: From critical minerals to agriculture and clean energy, the Democratic Republic of Congo offers some of the world's most significant untapped opportunities.

mining.title: Mining & Critical Minerals
mining.desc: Cobalt, copper, gold, coltan and lithium — the DRC holds some of the world's largest reserves of the minerals powering the energy transition.

agriculture.title: Agriculture & Agri-business
agriculture.desc: Vast arable land and a favorable climate for coffee, cocoa, palm oil and staple crops — a largely untapped agricultural frontier.

energy.title: Energy & Hydropower
energy.desc: Immense hydropower potential, led by the Inga site on the Congo River — among the largest hydroelectric opportunities on the planet.

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure
infrastructure.desc: Roads, bridges, ports, housing and digital networks — large-scale projects connecting the DRC's cities and trade corridors.

forestry.title: Forestry & Timber
forestry.desc: The Congo Basin — the world's second-largest rainforest — offers sustainable timber and a globally vital carbon sink.

manufacturing.title: Manufacturing & Industry
manufacturing.desc: Local processing and value addition, from mineral refining to agri-processing, turning raw resources into finished goods.

whyDrc.title: A market at the heart of Africa
whyDrc.subtitle: Few countries combine the DRC's natural wealth, scale and strategic position. The fundamentals make the case.

acceptance.heading: {number}. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.body: By accessing and using TradeInDRC, you accept and agree to be bound by the terms and provisions of this agreement and the laws of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. If you do not agree to abide by these terms, please do not use this service.

description.heading: {number}. Description of Service
description.body: TradeInDRC is an official B2B trade portal connecting verified Congolese businesses with international buyers and partners. The platform provides company directory services, secure messaging, and trade opportunity listings.

registration.heading: {number}. User Registration
registration.body: To access certain features, you must register for an account. You agree to provide accurate, current, and complete information during registration and to update such information to keep it accurate.

verification.heading: {number}. Verification Process
verification.body: Company verification is conducted by authorized Ministry of Trade representatives. The "Verified" badge is a government-issued status. Submission of fraudulent documents will result in immediate account termination, blacklisting, and may lead to legal action under the DRC Penal Code.

conduct.heading: {number}. User Conduct
conduct.body: Users agree not to use the platform for any unlawful purpose, to spam other users, or to misrepresent their identity or business credentials.

intellectualProperty.heading: {number}. Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.body: All content on TradeInDRC, including logos, text, and images, is the property of the DRC government or its content suppliers and is protected by applicable intellectual property laws.

liability.heading: {number}. Limitation of Liability
liability.body: TradeInDRC shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages resulting from your use of the service.

contact.heading: {number}. Contact
contact.body: For questions about these Terms, please contact us at legal@tradeindrc.com

collect.heading: {number}. Information We Collect
collect.body: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, register a company, or contact us for support. This includes your name, email address, company information, and verification documents.

use.heading: {number}. How We Use Your Information
use.body: We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve our services, process verification applications, send you technical notices and support messages, and respond to your inquiries.

sharing.heading: {number}. Information Sharing
sharing.body: We may share your public company profile information with other users of the platform. Verification documents are shared only with authorized Ministry representatives for review purposes.

security.heading: {number}. Data Security
security.body: We take reasonable measures to help protect information about you from loss, theft, misuse, and unauthorized access. However, no security system is impenetrable.

retention.heading: {number}. Data Retention
retention.body: We store your information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you services. You may request deletion of your account at any time.

rights.heading: {number}. Your Rights (DRC Digital Code)
rights.body: In accordance with Law No. 20/017 of November 25, 2020 on Telecommunications and Information and Communication Technologies (Digital Code), you have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. Contact us at privacy@tradeindrc.com to exercise these rights.

governmentSharing.heading: {number}. Government Data Sharing
governmentSharing.body: By using this platform, you acknowledge that TradeInDRC is an official initiative. Data provided during the company registration process, including tax IDs and legal documents, is shared directly with the Ministry of Trade and relevant government bodies solely for the purpose of verification and accreditation. We do not sell this data to commercial third parties.

changes.heading: {number}. Changes to This Policy
changes.body: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page.

Cookies.title: Cookie Policy
Cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how TradeInDRC ("we", "us", and "our") uses cookies and similar technologies to recognize you when you visit our website. It explains what these technologies are and why we use them, as well as your rights to control our use of them.

what.heading: 1. What are cookies?
what.body: Cookies are small data files that are placed on your computer or mobile device when you visit a website. Cookies are widely used by website owners in order to make their websites work, or to work more efficiently, as well as to provide reporting information.

why.heading: 2. Why do we use cookies?
why.body: We use first-party and third-party cookies for several reasons. Some cookies are required for technical reasons in order for our Website to operate, and we refer to these as "essential" or "strictly necessary" cookies. Other cookies also enable us to track and target the interests of our users to enhance the experience on our Online Properties.

control.heading: 4. How can I control cookies?
control.body: You have the right to decide whether to accept or reject cookies. You can set or amend your web browser controls to accept or refuse cookies. If you choose to reject cookies, you may still use our website though your access to some functionality and areas of our website may be restricted.

updates.heading: 5. Updates to this Policy
updates.body: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time in order to reflect, for example, changes to the cookies we use or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. Please therefore re-visit this Cookie Policy regularly to stay informed about our use of cookies and related technologies.

contact.heading: 6. Contact Us
contact.body: If you have specific questions about our use of cookies, please email us at privacy@tradeindrc.com.

essential.title: Essential Cookies
essential.body: These cookies are strictly necessary to provide you with services available through our Website and to use some of its features, such as access to secure areas.

analytics.title: Performance & Analytics Cookies
analytics.body: These cookies are used to enhance the performance and functionality of our Website but are non-essential to their use. However, without these cookies, certain functionality (like videos) may become unavailable.

functionality.title: Functionality Cookies
functionality.body: These cookies allow us to remember choices you make when you use our Website, such as remembering your language preference or login details.
